verses.pali: “Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, devānaṁ devapadāni avisuddhānaṁ sattānaṁ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṁ sattānaṁ pariyodapanāya.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these four footprints of the gods are in order to purify unpurified beings and cleanse unclean beings.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti—
verses.english: Firstly, a noble disciple has experiential confidence in the Buddha …

verses.pali: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṁ buddho bhagavāti.
Idaṁ paṭhamaṁ devānaṁ devapadaṁ avisuddhānaṁ sattānaṁ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṁ sattānaṁ pariyodapanāya.
verses.english: This is the first footprint of the gods in order to purify unpurified beings and cleanse unclean beings.
Furthermore, a noble disciple has experiential confidence in the teaching …

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṁvattanikehi.
verses.english: Furthermore, a noble disciple’s ethical conduct is loved by the noble ones, unbroken, impeccable, spotless, and unmarred, liberating, praised by sensible people, not mistaken, and leading to immersion.

verses.pali: Idaṁ catutthaṁ devānaṁ devapadaṁ avisuddhānaṁ sattānaṁ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṁ sattānaṁ pariyodapanāya.
verses.english: This is the fourth footprint of the gods in order to purify unpurified beings and cleanse unclean beings.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri devānaṁ devapadāni avisuddhānaṁ sattānaṁ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṁ sattānaṁ pariyodapanāyā”ti.
verses.english: These four footprints of the gods are in order to purify unpurified beings and cleanse unclean beings.”
